name: Panel
summary: A plain bordered box split into header, body sections and footer, lighter than a card.
description: Use a panel for settings groups and detail views where sections should run edge to edge with rules between them. It has no padding, shadow or sheen of its own; for a standalone item, use a card.

classes.name: v-panel
classes.description: The box. Each direct child gets a rule above it.

classes.name: v-panel-header
classes.description: A row with the title at the start and an action or badge at the end.

classes.name: v-panel-body
classes.description: A padded section. Use several for separate blocks.

classes.name: v-panel-footer
classes.description: Actions aligned to the end, on a subtle background, pushed to the bottom.

a11y: Use a heading element for .v-panel-title, at the right level for the page.
If the panel is a page region, use <section aria-labelledby> pointing at the title.
Put the main action last in the footer so it is also last in tab order.
